facts.text: MK tries to pry his attacker's hand off his throat.
MK manages to blink his gold vision back on after being attacked.
MK sees that his attacker is a monkey with dark hair.
The monkey has one eye scarred.
The monkey is dressed in rags.
The monkey is covered in fresh wounds.
The monkey holds a staff with black spikes at either end.
The monkey has a purple aura.
MK thinks the attacker must be the demon.
MK pleads with the monkey not to hurt him.
The monkey holding MK against the wall looks surprised when hearing MK's voice.
The monkey blinks and his eyes glow lavender.
The monkey seems to activate night vision to examine MK.
The monkey releases MK after examining him.
The monkey says MK got past the seal.
The monkey says MK isn't "him".
MK asks who the monkey means.
The monkey says MK isn't "Wukong".
The monkey suddenly drops his staff.
The monkey grabs his head.
The monkey screams as though saying "Wukong" causes him pain.
MK pulls out his own staff.
MK is ready to defend himself if needed.
The user requests writing only the scenes described and not what happens next unless specified.

events.text: MK is attacked by a dark-haired monkey holding a spiked staff with a purple aura
The monkey releases MK after activating lavender night vision and says MK got past the seal but isn't "him"
The monkey says MK isn't "Wukong" and screams while grabbing his head
